2608.03487.title: RAG-Stack: Co-Optimizing RAG Serving Performance and Quality
2608.03487.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which augments large language model (LLM) generation with information retrieved from databases, has become a widely used approach for knowledge-intensive applications. Modern RAG systems, however, expose many configuration choices, such as retrieval indexes, model selections, and how models invoke retrieval. Each configuration yields a different trade-off between answer quality and serving performance, making it challenging to choose the optimal setting for a specific application deployment. We present RAG-Stack, a framework for efficiently discovering quality-performance Pareto frontiers across diverse RAG applications and serving systems. RAG-Stack consists of RAG-PE, an iterative design-space exploration algorithm that selects the next RAG configuration to evaluate; RAG-IR, a workload abstraction for diverse RAG algorithms; and RAG-CM, a performance model that predicts the optimal deployment and serving performance on the given hardware. Together, these components allow RAG-Stack to search the joint algorithm-system configuration space without deploying every candidate and to transfer an existing Pareto frontier to a new serving system. Given the same number of optimization iterations across diverse datasets, the Pareto frontiers found by RAG-Stack cover 52.5% to 153.2% more of the normalized quality-performance space than those found by state-of-the-art configuration-search methods evaluated over the same RAG design space.
2608.03487.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通過從數據庫檢索的信息來增強大型語言模型（LLM）的生成，已成為知識密集型應用中廣泛使用的方法。然而，現代RAG系統暴露出許多配置選擇，例如檢索索引、模型選擇以及模型如何調用檢索。每種配置在答案質量和服務性能之間產生不同的權衡，這使得為特定應用部署選擇最佳設置變得具有挑戰性。我們提出了RAG-Stack，一個高效發現各種RAG應用和服務系統之間質量-性能Pareto邊界的框架。RAG-Stack由RAG-PE組成，這是一種迭代設計空間探索算法，用於選擇下一個要評估的RAG配置；RAG-IR是一種針對多種RAG算法的工作負載抽象；RAG-CM是一個性能模型，能夠預測在給定硬件上的最佳部署和服務性能。這些組件共同使RAG-Stack能夠在不部署每個候選者的情況下搜索聯合算法-系統配置空間，並將現有的Pareto邊界轉移到新的服務系統上。在不同數據集上進行相同數量的優化迭代時，RAG-Stack找到的Pareto邊界覆蓋了比在相同RAG設計空間上評估的最先進配置搜索方法多52.5%到153.2%的標準化質量-性能空間。
